blind_reader_rulings.item: R3 item 5(a) — local tradition + imported material = contradiction
blind_reader_rulings.ruling: REJECTED — faithful rendering of the pairing the source itself now states; not a translation defect.
blind_reader_rulings.reason: Round 3 made both sources state exactly this pairing: ar «على طريقة العمارة المحلية … والشندل (خشبٌ كان يُجلب إلى الخليج)», en «in the local building tradition … chandal wood (timber once imported to the Gulf)». A local way of building that used a timber brought into the Gulf is not a logical contradiction: «местного» modifies the tradition, not the materials, and the gloss places the import within Gulf building practice. The round progression shows the remedy worked: R1 read a false claim (all materials local -> contradiction), R2 an open question (local or imported?), R3 the question is answered and what remains is the reader's reaction to the source's own information. Same ruling as the zh judge (out/zh/07.json). Removing the tension would require dropping «местного» (reopens the locked lead-in, erases a source distinction) or naming the origin (adds a fact the BRIEF fences out).

blind_reader_rulings.item: R3 item 5 — from where was it imported? not said
blind_reader_rulings.reason: BRIEF round 3: the specific origin (East Africa/India) is disputed and not to be stated; neither source names it. Logged for Eyad as a source-level choice.

blind_reader_rulings.item: R3 item 5(b) — «регион Залива» read as a calque; reader wants «Персидского залива» or «привозили издалека»; alternative «привозного дерева шандаль»
blind_reader_rulings.reason: «Персидский залив» is barred by the sourced project decision in termbase entry «the Gulf» (2026-09-05, parallel to zh 海湾 and de Golfregion), which lists «Залив / регион Залива» and records them as established in diplomatic Russian; overruling a sourced entry on fluency alone is excluded by the rubric. «привозили издалека» drops «to the Gulf» and adds a distance claim the source lacks. The reader's adjective «привозного дерева шандаль» (no bracket) renders only one of three source elements: it drops «once» (كان — the import is historical, not a standing property of the wood) and «to the Gulf» (the regional frame tying the timber to Gulf building), so it is less faithful. Minimal in-termbase alternatives considered: «в страны Залива» (narrows a historical regional trade to modern states) and «на побережье Залива» (adds a coastal limit) — neither beats «в регион Залива». Judge edit: none — the rubric gives the judge apply/reject/score/return, and no rejected observation leaves a defect needing one.
